caption: The drawing displays an ornate, flower-shaped object with a central round area and symmetrical, petal-like segments radiating outward. The primary color of the object is blue, with white decorative patterns along the edges of each segment and further white accents at the center and around the borders. The central area is circular with a white, scalloped ring surrounding a beige core. Below this main blue and white ornamental object, there is a simple black line drawing of a side view of the same object, showing a cylindrical core with a flat, round surface at one end and a screw protruding from the other end. The background is a plain, slightly yellowed off-white color. The name "Richard Barret" is written in small text near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Parian Ware Tie Back
